snippet.title: Grandma(88) – Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
What begins as a visit to your dying grandmother quickly turns into a journey through her shifting labyrinth of memories. Here, every contradiction can reshape the world around you. Listen closely and decide when to challenge her version of the past. But be careful: Trust becomes a resource and every doubt comes at a cost.

Grandma(88) explores family myths, silence and inherited narratives through an atmospheric mystery adventure. What’s left unsaid matters just as much as what is revealed.

Wishlist it now on Steam!
